name_zh: 數位病理與組織病理技術
intro_zh: 透過虛擬全玻片與病例，練習組織形態、病理診斷觀察與 H&E 病理學習。
intro_en: Explore virtual whole slides, histology, tissue morphology and case-based pathology.

name_zh: 細胞遺傳與染色體核型練習
intro_zh: 利用染色體排列教材練習核型與非整倍體辨識。
intro_en: Practice karyotype assembly and recognizing aneuploidy with chromosome images.

intro_zh: 認識流式細胞儀、螢光補償、門控及臨床免疫表型。
intro_en: Explore cytometry, fluorescence compensation, gating and immunophenotyping.
